gaps.explanation: Negative prefix for 'legal' is 'il-' before l: illegal.

gaps.sentence: The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.
This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).

gaps.sentence: He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.
